title: kb-sprint close cleanup compares branches against a stale local main from the orchestrator's worktree
goal: The /kb-sprint close cleanup fetches first and compares each branch against the integration ref (origin/main), not local main, in git cherry and in the git log trailer test: from an orchestrator in its own worktree local main stays behind (git refuses to move a branch another worktree has checked out), so git cherry main work/<id> printed about 140 '+' lines for a landed branch and the cleanup would keep every branch. Found by the SP-rhgeod5g review.
